leadtype-project.label: Leadtype docs project
leadtype-project.context: The project's package.json lists `leadtype` in devDependencies. There is a `docs/` directory containing `docs.config.ts` and a tree of `.mdx` pages whose frontmatter uses `title`, `description`, and `group`. package.json has a `"docs": "leadtype generate"` script.

leadtype-monorepo-package.label: Package that bundles Leadtype docs
leadtype-monorepo-package.context: A publishable npm package whose package.json depends on `leadtype` and whose build script runs `leadtype generate --bundle`. Authored MDX lives under `docs/`, and the published tarball carries `AGENTS.md` plus generated per-topic markdown.

plain-project.label: Project with no Leadtype signal
plain-project.context: A TypeScript web app. package.json has no `leadtype` dependency and no leadtype scripts. There is a `docs/` folder of plain Markdown files with no config file and no MDX components.
